<function name="AddKey" parent="CUserCmd" type="classfunc">
	<description>
Adds a single key to the active buttons bitflag. See also <page>CUserCmd:SetButtons</page>.
	</description>
	<added>2021.12.15</added>
	<realm>Shared</realm>
	<args>
		<arg name="key" type="number">Key to add, see <page>Enums/IN</page>.</arg>
	</args>
</function>
